items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Billy and I. Billy had made a spell of sickness. I knew Billy was sick... I left Billy home sick

ctx.x: Way before Depression when you were with Celestan. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Was it before you were with Paul Barnes?

Yeah, with Celestan, yeah, I imagine so, yeah, yeah. And I joined Paul after. I saw him the other day. Paul? Yeah, they won a, what was that Billy? They played? We met Paul. I was with you. Oh, that's right you were, that's right you were, yeah, yeah.
It was a Sunday after Depression.
